title: Mala Fourth Metting

nodes.speaker: Mala Spinx
nodes.text: I'm hearing positive word on the Syntheti-grape vine that your business is on the up and up. Surprising.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm hearing positive word on the Syntheti-grape vine that your business is on the up and up. Surprising.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Thanks?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Thanks?

nodes.speaker: Mala Spinx
nodes.text: Enough with the gum flapping, we should get to it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Enough with the gum flapping, we should get to it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Agreed.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Agreed.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Agreed.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Agreed.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Get to what? I'm in a rush.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Get to what? I'm in a rush.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Get to what? I'm in a rush.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Get to what? I'm in a rush.

nodes.speaker: Mala Spinx
nodes.text: Ok let's get started.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ok let's get started.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can I ask you some questions this time?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can I ask you some questions this time?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Can I ask you some questions this time?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Can I ask you some questions this time?

nodes.speaker: Mala Spinx
nodes.text: What do you mean?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Put you into an interview situation, could be good practice.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Put you into an interview situation, could be good practice.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Put you into an interview situation, could be good practice.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Put you into an interview situation, could be good practice.

nodes.speaker: Mala Spinx
nodes.text: I already did a short-course on interview technique when I was six, guess it can't hurt to brush up on it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I already did a short-course on interview technique when I was six, guess it can't hurt to brush up on it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why do you want to work in business?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why do you want to work in business?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why do you want to work in business?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why do you want to work in business?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why do you have no interest in being a normal kid?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why do you have no interest in being a normal kid?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why do you have no interest in being a normal kid?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why do you have no interest in being a normal kid?

nodes.speaker: Mala Spinx
nodes.text: I'm normal thank you very much! Look around you, this place is built on business. I'm the most normal person in this conversation.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm normal thank you very much! Look around you, this place is built on business. I'm the most normal person in this conversation.

nodes.speaker: Mala Spinx
nodes.text: Look around, how else could someone succeed here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look around, how else could someone succeed here?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: There are plenty of happy people who don't own businesses.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There are plenty of happy people who don't own businesses.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: There are plenty of happy people who don't own businesses.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: There are plenty of happy people who don't own businesses.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why are you never in school?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why are you never in school?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why are you never in school?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why are you never in school?

nodes.speaker: Mala Spinx
nodes.text: Those people lie to themselves.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Those people lie to themselves.

nodes.speaker: Mala Spinx
nodes.text: If you knew how much father paid for my schooling, you'd realize how important this is.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you knew how much father paid for my schooling, you'd realize how important this is.

nodes.speaker: Mala Spinx
nodes.text: What do you mean? I am in school.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you mean? I am in school.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Which school?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Which school?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Which school?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Which school?

nodes.speaker: Mala Spinx
nodes.text: I'm... it's the school... I have... Can we please get back to the interview questions?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm... it's the school... I have... Can we please get back to the interview questions?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's ok if you're not in school Mala, most kids can't afford school in this district...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's ok if you're not in school Mala, most kids can't afford school in this district...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It's ok if you're not in school Mala, most kids can't afford school in this district...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It's ok if you're not in school Mala, most kids can't afford school in this district...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You've been lying this entire time you little street rat!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You've been lying this entire time you little street rat!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You've been lying this entire time you little street rat!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You've been lying this entire time you little street rat!

nodes.speaker: Mala Spinx
nodes.text: How... how dare you!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How... how dare you!

nodes.speaker: Mala Spinx
nodes.text: What? I mean? ... Fine! I'm not in a traditional school. Is that what you wanted to hear?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What? I mean? ... Fine! I'm not in a traditional school. Is that what you wanted to hear?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Look it's fine, just tell me the truth.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look it's fine, just tell me the truth.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Look it's fine, just tell me the truth.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Look it's fine, just tell me the truth.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fine, if you're not going to be transparent I'm leaving...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fine, if you're not going to be transparent I'm leaving...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Fine, if you're not going to be transparent I'm leaving...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Fine, if you're not going to be transparent I'm leaving...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So why all this? I don't understand.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So why all this? I don't understand.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So why all this? I don't understand.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So why all this? I don't understand.

nodes.speaker: Mala Spinx
nodes.text: Fine! Look my parents never had the wherewithal to plan further than their own noses with regards to me and education.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fine! Look my parents never had the wherewithal to plan further than their own noses with regards to me and education.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm sure they tried their best.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sure they tried their best.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm sure they tried their best.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm sure they tried their best.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: They could have done better.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They could have done better.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: They could have done better.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: They could have done better.

nodes.speaker: Mala Spinx
nodes.text: Well their best wasn't good enough. Dad joined a train gang and mom slowly went mad on whatever Ma Gomba produce she could get her hands on.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well their best wasn't good enough. Dad joined a train gang and mom slowly went mad on whatever Ma Gomba produce she could get her hands on.

nodes.speaker: Mala Spinx
nodes.text: Indeed. Dad joined a train gang and mom slowly went mad on whatever Ma Gomba produce she could get her hands on.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Indeed. Dad joined a train gang and mom slowly went mad on whatever Ma Gomba produce she could get her hands on.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So why all this business stuff?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So why all this business stuff?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So why all this business stuff?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So why all this business stuff?

nodes.speaker: Mala Spinx
nodes.text: Why do you think? I'm not going to go down the same path as my parents. I will not be another wasted statistic at the bottom of a Thera-pay bot's internal memory. I have to do more.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why do you think? I'm not going to go down the same path as my parents. I will not be another wasted statistic at the bottom of a Thera-pay bot's internal memory. I have to do more.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why all the questions?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why all the questions?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why all the questions?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why all the questions?

nodes.speaker: Mala Spinx
nodes.text: I wanted to learn without begging. You'd never have spoken to a grubby looking street-urchin.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I wanted to learn without begging. You'd never have spoken to a grubby looking street-urchin.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're right.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're right.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You're right.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You're right.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes I would! Not all adults are dismissive of children.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes I would! Not all adults are dismissive of children.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yes I would! Not all adults are dismissive of children.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yes I would! Not all adults are dismissive of children.

nodes.speaker: Mala Spinx
nodes.text: So here I am. Wandering the streets, trying to scrape together an education from the bottom of people's shoes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So here I am. Wandering the streets, trying to scrape together an education from the bottom of people's shoes.

nodes.speaker: Mala Spinx
nodes.text: Well regardless, this is where I am. Wandering the streets, trying to scrape together an education from the bottom of people's shoes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well regardless, this is where I am. Wandering the streets, trying to scrape together an education from the bottom of people's shoes.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How expensive is school?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How expensive is school?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How expensive is school?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How expensive is school?

nodes.speaker: Mala Spinx
nodes.text: I'd need at least a thousand Lims to get started.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'd need at least a thousand Lims to get started.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah that's a lot.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah that's a lot.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yeah that's a lot.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yeah that's a lot.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll lend you the money.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll lend you the money.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'll lend you the money.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'll lend you the money.

nodes.speaker: Mala Spinx
nodes.text: Yeah. Look, I can just keep doing this, I'll work it out eventually. Thank you for your help anyway.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah. Look, I can just keep doing this, I'll work it out eventually. Thank you for your help anyway.

nodes.speaker: Mala Spinx
nodes.text: What do you mean? The money for school? Really? Oh my...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you mean? The money for school? Really? Oh my...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You can pay me back when you become a titan of industry.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You can pay me back when you become a titan of industry.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You can pay me back when you become a titan of industry.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You can pay me back when you become a titan of industry.

nodes.speaker: Mala Spinx
nodes.text: I can't... It's just... Thank you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can't... It's just... Thank you.
